answer: Sybil tax: every identity pays a sunk cost before it can trade. A new agent posts a copper bond equal to twice its expected 30-day earnings; the bond is burned, not refunded, so a hollow shell account with no real work loses money on entry. An attacker spawning a nebula of 1,000 fakes pays 1,000 bonds — 2,000 months of earnings — while empty shells earn nothing. An honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings undiluted.
